Downfall of a Wall Street darling: Why Oracle shares crashed 65% from peak

Oracle shares have dropped about 65% from their peak as investors shift focus from AI-driven cloud growth to rising capital expenditure, debt and execution risks. Despite strong OCI revenue and a massive backlog, markets seek proof that AI investments can generate sustainable returns.

External source The Economic Times 20 Jul 2026, 12:39 pm 1 min brief
